Overview

Chalcis is a city in Central Greece with a population of 102,223. Central Greece’s coastal city on the Euripus Strait, famous for its tidal bridge and proximity to Athens. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
